name: Modern Web Guidance
description: Steer coding agents to modern HTML, CSS and JavaScript: search and retrieve curated web-platform guides and scan a codebase for legacy patterns, from Google Chrome.

skills.name: Search Guides
skills.description: Searches the curated web-platform guides by task description, such as animating a dialog modal backdrop.

skills.name: Retrieve Guide
skills.description: Retrieves a guide by ID and returns its expert-curated guidance and fallbacks straight into the agent's context.

skills.name: Legacy Scan
skills.description: Scans a codebase for legacy patterns that modern browser APIs can replace, so the agent can modernize them.
